claim: Prove that norm-integrality cuts the exact quaternion order trace dual back down to the original perfect lattice, excluding any larger subring with integral reduced trace and norm.

obligations.name: Same algebra and integral order
obligations.required_input: The overorder result must concern the actual period lattice.
obligations.constructed_input: All nine predecessor sources are unchanged. The same subring uses the basis1,i,(1+j)/2,i/2+k/10, the same positive involution and the same unrescaled trace pairing.
obligations.justification: All nine predecessor sources are unchanged. The same subring uses the basis1,i,(1+j)/2,i/2+k/10, the same positive involution and the same unrescaled trace pairing.

obligations.name: Actual trace-dual inversion
obligations.required_input: An unspecified dual lattice or equal-rank substitute is insufficient.
obligations.constructed_input: Four literal tests Tr(x*e_i)=a,b,c,d give x=(a/2,−b/420,−a/10+c/5,−b/420+d/210), by the exact quaternion multiplication and same Gram.
obligations.justification: Four literal tests Tr(x*e_i)=a,b,c,d give x=(a/2,−b/420,−a/10+c/5,−b/420+d/210), by the exact quaternion multiplication and same Gram.

obligations.name: Norm and local factors
obligations.required_input: All coefficients and exceptional primes must survive normalization.
obligations.constructed_input: The exact norm times210 is F=42a²+42ac−b²+5bd−42c²−5d². All primes2,3,5,7 dividing210 are explicitly used.
obligations.justification: The exact norm times210 is F=42a²+42ac−b²+5bd−42c²−5d². All primes2,3,5,7 dividing210 are explicitly used.

obligations.name: Residue coverage
obligations.required_input: Finite local obstructions must cover every residue and the coupled conditions.
obligations.constructed_input: Full residue computations force b,d=0 at2,3,7, and b=0,a−2c=0 at5. Their combined conclusion is210|b,42|d,5|(a−2c). No condition at5 is dropped or replaced by independent coordinate vanishing.
obligations.justification: Full residue computations force b,d=0 at2,3,7, and b=0,a−2c=0 at5. Their combined conclusion is210|b,42|d,5|(a−2c). No condition at5 is dropped or replaced by independent coordinate vanishing.

obligations.name: Constructed lattice membership
obligations.required_input: Congruences must recover the original integral basis.
obligations.constructed_input: Writing b=210B,d=42D,a−2c=5A explicitly constructs original coordinates(c+3A,2B−D,−A,−5B+2D), whose embedding equals the same trace-dual quaternion.
obligations.justification: Writing b=210B,d=42D,a−2c=5A explicitly constructs original coordinates(c+3A,2B−D,−A,−5B+2D), whose embedding equals the same trace-dual quaternion.

obligations.name: Actual overorder maps
obligations.required_input: The comparison must use ring closure and the specified inclusion.
obligations.constructed_input: For S containing the original order, trace-integrality on S applies to each actual product x*e_i. Norm-integrality on the same x then proves x belongs to the original order; antisymmetry gives S=O.
obligations.justification: For S containing the original order, trace-integrality on S applies to each actual product x*e_i. Norm-integrality on the same x then proves x belongs to the original order; antisymmetry gives S=O.

obligations.name: Nonvacuous integral order hypotheses
obligations.required_input: The constructed order must itself satisfy the stated conditions.
obligations.constructed_input: Reduced trace and reduced norm are proved integer-valued on the original order, using its actual integer coordinates.
obligations.justification: Reduced trace and reduced norm are proved integer-valued on the original order, using its actual integer coordinates.

obligations.name: Remaining maximality/moduli bridge
obligations.required_input: A conditional overorder theorem is not yet all module-finite orders or an abelian scheme.
obligations.constructed_input: The bridge from arbitrary module-finite integral orders to reduced trace/norm integrality, exact local ramification classification, PEL scheme algebraization and contact identification remain separate. No generic maximal-order instance or principal polarization of an algebraic scheme is asserted here.
obligations.justification: The bridge from arbitrary module-finite integral orders to reduced trace/norm integrality, exact local ramification classification, PEL scheme algebraization and contact identification remain separate. No generic maximal-order instance or principal polarization of an algebraic scheme is asserted here.
